tier2.summary:
COMPLETE
  ✓ --skip-bad-lines mode reads salvageable rows with per-line evidence and exits 1 when anything was skipped; validate --repair writes tasks.rewritten.jsonl without touching tasks.jsonl; default abort behavior and existing tests unchanged; fixture tests prove both paths: All four sub-claims verified by code inspection AND fresh end-to-end execution. (1) --skip-bad-lines: cmd/boardctl/main.go:192 useSkipBad (default false), :197 armSkipBad, :204 reportSkipped prints RenderSkippedLines to stderr and returns 1, :218 exitError -> exit 1; internal/board/board.go:74 skipFailedLine records {Path, 1-based Line, Snippet, Err} only in SkipBad mode, :453 iterParsedTolerant parses each line individually and never aborts, :102 RenderSkippedLines. E2E on the 5-line/2-salvageable fixture: `list --skip-bad-lines` printed DF9-A + DF9-C to stdout, stderr 'SKIPPED-LINES: 3 line(s)...' with 'tasks.jsonl line 2/3/4: <parse error>' + snippet, exit=1. Wired on list/show/stats/validate/render (main.go:363,457,1010,841; render.go:34). (2) validate --repair: internal/board/repair.go:66 Repair() snapshots tasks.jsonl, re-reads tolerantly, writes ONLY filepath.Join(b.Dir,'tasks.rewritten.jsonl') (:88), then asserts bytes.Equal(before,after) (:96-101). E2E: exit=0, stdout 'wrote 2 salvaged row(s)... dropped 3 unparseable line(s) (tasks.jsonl line(s): 2, 3, 4)' + 'FOR MANUAL REVIEW ... tasks.jsonl was NOT modified'; `md5sum -c` on tasks.jsonl/events.jsonl/board.jsonl all OK (byte-identical); tasks.rewritten.jsonl holds exactly the 2 salvageable rows. (3) Default abort unchanged: read.go TaskRows/EventsForTask and doctor.go gate the tolerant path behind `if b.SkipBad`, default arm still calls IterParsed/ReadAllRows; E2E default `list` -> 'tasks.jsonl: line 2: unexpected EOF', no rows, exit=1; default `validate` -> '[error] tasks.jsonl: line 2: unexpected EOF', RESULT: FAIL, exit=1. (4) Existing tests unchanged: `git diff 2162aab HEAD --name-only` lists only 10 files and the only test files touched are the two NEW ones (cmd/boardctl/df_boardctl_9_test.go, internal/board/df_boardctl_9_test.go) — no pre-existing test modified; the merge commit 1c54dbb resolved correctly, preserving DF-BOARDCTL-8 Days labels (derive.go:310, template.go:714) and BT-048 priority warns (validate.go:150-166). (5) Fixture tests prove both paths: 7 board tests (TestDF9DefaultReadAborts, TestDF9SkipBadSalvagesAndRecordsEvidence, TestDF9SkipSnippetCappedAt120, TestDF9SkipBadStatsAndList, TestDF9ValidateDefaultAndTolerant, TestDF9RepairSalvagesToReviewFile, TestDF9RepairOnCleanBoardIsNoopRewrite) + 6 CLI tests (TestDF9CLIDefaultListAborts, TestDF9CLIListSkipBad, TestDF9CLIFlagsInUsage, TestDF9CLIRepair, TestDF9CLICleanBoardNoop, TestDF9CLIStatsSkipBad), using the measured dogfood corruption fixture (clean, truncated, embedded-raw-newline x2, clean = 5 physical lines, 2 salvageable). TEST EVIDENCE (fresh, cache-defeating): `go build ./...` exit 0; `go vet ./...` exit 0; `go test -count=1 ./...` exit 0 with 6 'ok' lines and no FAIL/panic; `go test -count=1 -v -run DF9 ./internal/board ./cmd/boardctl` -> all 13 DF9 tests PASS; LSP diagnostics 0 findings.
DF-BOARDCTL-9 fully satisfies its criterion: --skip-bad-lines salvages rows with per-line evidence and exits 1, validate --repair writes only tasks.rewritten.jsonl leaving tasks.jsonl byte-identical, default abort behavior and all pre-existing tests are unchanged, and 13 new fixture tests plus fresh `go test -count=1 ./...` (exit 0) prove both paths.
